entities.brief: Projected breakdown of $2.9tr data center capex 2025-2028
entities.description: Breakdown of global data center capex (ex. power) into internal cash flows, private credit, corporate debt, ABS & CMBS, and other capital

properties.table_content:
| Category | Sub-Category/Source | Estimated Amount ($bn) |
|---|---|---|
| Cash Need | Total Global Capex on Data Centers (ex. Power) | 2,900 |
| Financing Path | Hyperscaler Capex Funded with Cash Flows | 1,400 |
| Financing Path | Corporate Debt | 200 |
| Financing Path | ABS & CMBS | 150 |
| Financing Path | Private Credit Opportunity | 800 |
| Financing Path | Other Capital (PE, VC, Sovereign) | 350 |
properties.key_insight: Nearly half of the $2.9tr data center capex is funded by hyperscaler cash flows, with the remainder supplemented by private credit, corporate debt, ABS & CMBS, and other capital
